sql: with f as (select distinct lo.market_ticker from live_orders lo where lo.strategy='Dmmsell10' and lo.action='buy' and lo.status='filled'), snap as (select f.market_ticker, (select coalesce(p.quantity_fp,p.quantity) from positions p where p.market_ticker=f.market_ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1) as qty, (select p.realized_pnl from positions p where p.market_ticker=f.market_ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1) as realized, (select p.market_exposure from positions p where p.market_ticker=f.market_ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1) as exposure from f) select count(*) as filled_markets, count(*) filter (where qty is not null and abs(qty)>0.01) as still_open, count(*) filter (where qty is not null and abs(qty)<=0.01) as settled_flat, round(sum(coalesce(realized,0))::numeric,2) as realized_pnl_usd, round(sum(coalesce(exposure,0))::numeric,2) as open_exposure_usd, round((100.0*sum(case when coalesce(realized,0)>0 then 1 else 0 end)/nullif(count(*) filter (where qty is not null and abs(qty)<=0.01),0))::numeric,1) as win_rate_pct from snap
